text_1989: Had your Lord willed, all the people would have been one {believing) congregation. But they will always dispute {the truth).
text_ref: Had your Lord willed, all the people would have been one congregation (of believers). But they will always dispute (the truth).

text_1981: Only those blessed with mercy from your Lord (will not dispute the truth). This is why He created them.* The judgment of your Lord has already been issued: "I will fill Hell with jinns and humans, all together."**
footnote_1981:
*11:119 The Most Merciful has created us on this earth to give us yet another chance to denounce our original crime and to be redeemed (see the Introduction and Appendix 7).

**11:119 God does not put a single person in Hell; they choose and insist upon going to Hell.
text_1989: Except for those redeemed by your Lord. This is why He created them.* “I will fill Hell with jinns and humans, all together.”
text_ref: Only those blessed with mercy from your Lord (will not dispute the truth). This is why He created them.* The judgment of your Lord has already been issued: "I will fill Hell with jinns and humans, all together."**
footnote_ref:
*11:119 The Most Merciful has created us on this earth to give us yet another chance to denounce our original crime and to be redeemed (see the Introduction and Appendix 7).

**11:119 God does not put a single person in Hell; they choose and insist upon going to Hell.

text_1981: We narrate to you enough history of the messengers to strengthen your heart. The truth has come to you herein, as well as enlightenments and reminders for the believers.
text_1989: We narrate to you enough history of the messengers to strengthen your heart. and enlightenment, and a reminder for the believers.
text_ref: We narrate to you enough history of the messengers to strengthen your heart. The truth has come to you herein, as well as enlightenments and reminders for the believers.

text_1981: Say to those who disbelieve, "Do whatever you can, and so will we.
text_1989: Say to those who disbelieve, “Do whatever you can, and so will we.
text_ref: Say to those who disbelieve, "Do whatever you can, and so will we.

text_1981: “Then wait, and we will wait.” T?3^ To God belongs the future of the heavens and the earth.
text_1989: “Then wait; we too will wait.”
text_ref: "Then wait; we too will wait."

text_1981: To GOD belongs the future of the heavens and the earth, and all matters are controlled by Him. You shall worship Him and trust in Him. Your Lord is never unaware of anything you do.
text_1989: To GOD belongs the future of the heavens and the earth; all matters will be returned to Him. you shall worship Him and put your trust in Him. unaware of anything you do.
text_ref: To GOD belongs the future of the heavens and the earth, and all matters are controlled by Him. You shall worship Him and trust in Him. Your Lord is never unaware of anything you do.
